response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), compared AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE transaction_count > average_count;
